items.title: Sam Kininger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 27, 2011
items.q: now that Jeff Coffin is in the band, who I’ve been friends with

ctx.x: But you were never one of those people who, from my memory, that you agonized over your equipment.

Yeah I kind of stay with the same thing, forever, really, and see I mean I’ve stayed with Rovner ligatures, it’s kind of a newer model that they’ve come out with. Reeds I changed. I get a different reed, every box. I still have a hard time finding the right one. For instance these are Vandoren Java 2-1/2’s but I’ve even tried using tenors. Jeff Coffin is the saxophone player with Dave Mathews right now? And I had asked him, because I went to

a show one time, and I said, “What are you playing now, for your alto?” And he goes 3- 1/2 Java tenors. I’m like what? So I started doing that, and I got used to it for a while, but I gravitated down. But it’s the one thing I would change the most is reeds.
